title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.Odd.of_mul_left
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.Odd.of_mul_left` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {m n : ℕ}, Odd (m * n) → Odd m
formal.kernel_statement: ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat.Odd (AxNat.mul x0 x1)) -> AxNat.Odd x0)))
